clue.text: Hard work to put a stop to children's game

parts.note: H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
OP, short for opus, is a musical work
to scotch a plan is to put a stop to it

explanation.surface: Someone toiling to end a playground pastime.
explanation.definitionFit: The playground jumping game played on chalked squares is a classic children's pastime.

clue.text: Damage surrounding eastern women's quarters

indicators.note: the word for damage is placed around the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: to harm is to damage

explanation.surface: Vandalism around an Eastern residence's female section.
explanation.definitionFit: In a traditional Muslim household the secluded rooms set apart for the wives and female relatives bear this name.

clue.text: Mate, sickly-looking, lacking energy

indicators.note: lacking says a letter is missing from the word for sickly-looking

parts.note: pale means wan or sickly-looking
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A friend who looks peaky and has no get-up-and-go.
explanation.definitionFit: Mate and this word are both informal synonyms for a friend.

clue.text: Spooner's type of music teacher could be a pest

indicators.note: Spooner's signals swapping the opening sounds of the two words, after the Reverend Spooner

parts.note: rock is a type of music
a coach is a teacher or trainer

explanation.surface: A garbled music tutor turns out to be vermin.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the initial sounds of ROCK COACH gives the insect.
explanation.definitionFit: The scuttling household insect is a notorious pest in kitchens.

clue.text: Bid a lot, stupidly, for newspaper

indicators.note: doing something stupidly means doing it in a muddled way, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: An auction bidder overpaying foolishly for a paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A small-format popular paper, often sensational, is a type of newspaper.

clue.text: Mostly horrible time in refuge

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all of the word for horrible, so its last letter goes

parts.note: hideous means horrible

explanation.surface: A grim period spent in a shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: A hiding place where one shelters from pursuers is a refuge.

clue.text: Racket made by little monkey losing tail

indicators.note: losing its tail means the last letter of the word for a little monkey is dropped

parts.note: a scamp, like a little monkey, is a mischievous child

explanation.surface: A noise made by a small primate with no tail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Racket' suggests noise, but here it is a swindle; 'little monkey' is a naughty child, not an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A racket is a fraudulent scheme, a swindle or con.

clue.text: Astute keeping with previous word- processing technique?

indicators.note: keeping means holding the other pieces inside the word for astute

parts.note: cute can mean shrewd or astute
and means with, together
past means previous

explanation.surface: A shrewd writer reusing earlier wording.
explanation.definitionFit: Copying text out of one place and inserting it elsewhere is a basic editing operation in word processors.

clue.text: Guy that redesigned an area of New York City

parts.note: a guy is a man

indicators.note: redesigned means remade in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man who replanned part of New York.
explanation.definitionFit: The island borough at the heart of New York City is one of its five boroughs.

clue.text: Backchat involving male, not firm

indicators.note: involving means taking in the other piece, here placed inside

parts.note: lip is cheek or backchat

explanation.surface: A cheeky reply from a man that lacks conviction.
explanation.definitionFit: Something floppy and lacking stiffness is not firm.

clue.text: Inside barrel, I concealed ancient artefact

indicators.note: inside says the letters lie within the run of clue words that follows

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to hiding an antique in a cask.
explanation.walkthrough: 'concealed' reads as the hiding signal, but its C is part of the letters; 'Inside' signals the hidden word.
explanation.definitionFit: An object surviving from a past age is a historical artefact.

clue.text: Difficult to make money playing sport

parts.note: bad can mean difficult, as in a bad situation
to mint is to make coins, literally to make money
on means playing, as an actor on stage

explanation.surface: Turning professional at a game is hard to profit from.
explanation.definitionFit: The racket game with a shuttlecock is an Olympic sport.

clue.text: Chief steward in rank bad mood

parts.note: major is a military rank

indicators.note: bad suggests something gone wrong, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: The head of household staff is in a foul temper.
explanation.definitionFit: The head servant running a large household is its chief steward or butler.

clue.text: Toy figure passing over flag

parts.note: jumping means leaping or passing over
a jack is a flag flown at a ship's bow

explanation.surface: A toy that sails over a flag.
explanation.definitionFit: A jointed puppet figure whose limbs jerk up when a string is pulled is a traditional toy.

clue.text: Animal emerging from outskirts of Pamplona?

parts.note: a city's outskirts are its edges, so the picture is the first and last letters of the name, listed as a pair

explanation.surface: A beast appearing from the edge of a Spanish city.
explanation.walkthrough: The outskirts of Pamplona are its first and last letters; naming the pair with the joining word between them, run together as one word, gives the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The black-and-white bear of China is a well-known animal.

clue.text: Attack doctor splitting commission

indicators.note: splitting means the doctor goes into the word for commission, dividing it

parts.note: a board is a commission or official body
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, stands for a doctor

explanation.surface: A medic attacking and dividing an official committee.
explanation.definitionFit: To shell a position heavily is to attack it.

clue.text: One harvesting honey, perhaps bitter about English preserve

indicators.note: about means around, so the word for bitter goes around the other pieces

parts.note: bitter is a type of beer
to keep is to preserve

explanation.surface: A honey collector wrapped up in ale and English jam.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who tends hives collects their honey, though the 'perhaps' admits other tasks.

clue.text: Mutter vaguely about parking for member of orchestra

indicators.note: about means around, so the scrambled letters surround the parking sign
vaguely suggests a blurred version, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A musician grumbles indistinctly about where to park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vaguely' mixes MUTTER to TRUMET; 'about' wraps that around P.
explanation.definitionFit: The brass instrument is a section member in an orchestra.

clue.text: Wicked lunatic? He reformed

indicators.note: reformed means formed anew, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Was the wicked madman reformed?
explanation.definitionFit: Morally wrong conduct is wicked in a broad sense.

clue.text: Descriptive term I applied to record Greek character cut

indicators.note: applied to means placed alongside, so the I goes after the record

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record

indicators.note: cut means the last letter of the Greek letter's name is lopped off

parts.note: theta is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A label stuck on a record with a Greek letter trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: A word or phrase characterising a person, like 'the Great', is a descriptive term.

clue.text: See acrobat in glass

definitions.meaning: a gymnast who performs somersaults and flips
a flat-bottomed drinking glass without a stem

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a somersaulting performer and a straight-sided drinking vessel.

clue.text: Relative measures nothing new

parts.note: steps are measures, as in taking steps
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A relation's actions accomplish nothing fresh.
explanation.definitionFit: A spouse's son from an earlier marriage is a relative by marriage.

clue.text: Please say if it's awkward without one

indicators.note: awkward suggests clumsily arranged, so these letters are jumbled once one letter is set aside

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A request to speak up if something is uncomfortable, minus one person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awkward' scrambles SAY IF IT'S, and 'without one' sets aside one I from those letters, leaving the seven needed.
explanation.definitionFit: To please someone is to gratify or content them.

clue.text: Avid listener, for example, back inside

indicators.note: inside means placed within the word for listener

parts.note: an ear is a listener, the organ of hearing

indicators.note: back means the abbreviation is read backwards

explanation.surface: A keen listener turned around, for instance.
explanation.definitionFit: Avid and this word both describe being keen or enthusiastic.

clue.text: Break from cover if threatened

indicators.note: from says the letters are taken out of the run of clue words that follows

explanation.surface: Bolting from shelter when menaced.
explanation.definitionFit: A crack or split is a break; also a breach between people.

clue.text: Unbeatable in game against minor

parts.note: a match is a game
less means minor, smaller

explanation.surface: Invincible in a contest with a youngster.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without equal can't be matched, so it is unbeatable.

clue.text: Reportedly, rustic steps in vogue

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so the word is one that sounds like another

parts.note: a stile is a set of steps over a country fence

explanation.surface: Countryside steps are said to be fashionable.
explanation.walkthrough: A stile is a step or set of steps letting walkers cross a farm wall or fence in the British countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in vogue is being in fashion, and fashion is a sense of the word.

clue.text: Forte associated with all in screwball parts?

definitions.text: Forte associated with all in screwball parts?

indicators.note: in means placed within the scrambled letters
screwball means crazy, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: F is the musical abbreviation for forte, loud

explanation.surface: A clown's speciality, common to all roles in a slapstick comedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'screwball' rearranges and 'in' inserts. Read whole, the clue also describes comic tumbles as the strong suit of performers in screwball roles, an all-in-one clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Comic falls onto the backside are a staple of screwball comedy roles.

clue.text: Careful, cleaner close to crockery

parts.note: a char is a cleaning woman, a charlady

indicators.note: close to means the end of the word, its last letter

explanation.surface: A cleaning lady handling the crockery with care.
explanation.walkthrough: A char is a British word for a woman paid to clean houses.
explanation.definitionFit: Being wary or cautious is being careful.

clue.text: Quite a large lake

explanation.surface: A fairly big body of water.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adverb, as in 'all alone', it means completely, which is one sense of quite.

clue.text: Playboy? // One may see croupier with one

definitions.meaning: a dissolute pleasure-seeking man, a libertine

definitions.text: One may see croupier with one
definitions.meaning: a long-handled tool a croupier uses to gather chips

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a womanising libertine and a casino attendant's long chip-gathering stick.

clue.text: Colour of ball you're playing

indicators.note: playing suggests moving about freely, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The shade of the ball you are using in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep bright shade of blue is a colour.
